nodes.rationale: ENABLED events mean configuration only; confirmation requires CONFIRMED event and order status in the same transaction.

nodes.label: Admin account management
nodes.rationale: Protect self and last active Admin; restrict deletes with business references; serialize updates.

nodes.label: Admin dashboard
nodes.rationale: Revenue counts PAID orders grouped by creation day UTC, not the date cash was received.

nodes.rationale: Unique module/order/kind avoids duplicate decision events.

nodes.label: Serializable AI decisions
nodes.rationale: Order confirmation and event are atomic; module lock serializes disabling with worker decisions.

nodes.label: Checkout transaction
nodes.rationale: Server calculates prices, writes order/details, deducts stock and updates cart in a transaction.

nodes.label: Inventory management
nodes.rationale: Expected quantity detects stale updates; stock and movement audit commit together.

nodes.label: Manual bank confirmation
nodes.rationale: QR is not payment evidence; staff records PAID and OrderNotes atomically without changing inventory.

nodes.label: Order historical snapshots
nodes.rationale: UnitPrice, recipient and total snapshots preserve transaction history despite later profile or price changes.

nodes.label: Website availability
nodes.rationale: IsOpen blocks customer and staff business APIs with 503 while Admin access and login remain available.

nodes.label: Database bank settings
nodes.rationale: PaymentService now reads ShopSettings instead of Payments:Bank; changed bank settings affect newly generated QR for existing unpaid orders.

nodes.label: Original Home content overrides
nodes.rationale: HomeContentJson overrides original homeDefaults.ts; blank string intentionally clears text.

nodes.label: ShopSettings configuration
nodes.rationale: Single row stores shop and bank configuration; no seeded business data.

nodes.label: Assigned customer support chat
nodes.rationale: JWT identifies sender; conversation ownership restricts access and read cursor marks only loaded messages.

nodes.label: InventoryMovements audit
nodes.source_location: Schema mở rộng đã được người dùng duyệt

nodes.label: Order lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Cancellation restores inventory; receipt confirmation does not automatically change payment status.

nodes.label: Database-backed UI and engineering rules
nodes.rationale: Require schema mapping, real data, empty states and simple implementations.

nodes.label: React storefront architecture
nodes.rationale: Active src does not import the retained src_backup; token remains in memory and reload requires login.

nodes.label: Category management
nodes.rationale: Cannot delete categories containing products; FK protects concurrent additions.

nodes.label: Product management
nodes.rationale: Use product ID instead of SKU; deactivate rather than permanently delete products.
